metadata: Only texture public slots change. Membership-unchanged E still has pool count +2 combined, +1 per arm; A-E have +1 per arm. F public slots are unchanged. Lower internal rank changes elsewhere are not extra public losses.
noncore_limit: Removed IDs have no duplicate elsewhere in genuine BEFORE packs. Holding those non-core routes fixed yields a conditional accounting union only; actual AFTER non-core routes were not run. No complete old exposed substitute was established.
before_choice_review: No exposed selectable payload or complete combination independently states A/B interior-to-exterior relation. Core already preserves requested opening/cut face; this is a candidate-support gap, not inability to meet the request. Existing compatible supports remain. Clarifications are not extra selectable choices.
wall_authority: B wall repair affects material only. It cannot itself create a visible wall or rename the board/counter as wall paint. A separate setting/framing/composition choice could establish a restrained wall while preserving requested loaf/board/cut-face focus, but no composition, final-scene witness or audit receipt demonstrates this path. Full-meaning adoptability and utility remain conditional.
causal_limit: Both single-row arms retain B handling trace; its combined loss is joint two-row allocation in this frozen comparison, not a general ranking theorem. A trace loss remains pastry-linked.
